libvirtd_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for libvirtd to wait for clients before shutting down if no VMs are running.

qemu_audio_drv.description: Default audio driver for QEMU/SDL graphics.

start_libvirtd.description: Whether to start libvirtd at boot when using sysvinit.

mount_cgroups.description: Whether to mount a systemd-like cgroup layout (sysvinit only).

cgroups_list.description: List of cgroups to mount (sysvinit only, space-separated in the final config).
